parsed.summary: After tracing the power rails (XT60 -> 10 mOhm shunt + INA219 at 0x40 -> MIC26903 buck with a 6.8k/1.3k divider giving ~5V and a 15uH L2 -> LD39200PU33R fixed LDO with ADJ/SENSE tied to OUT and EN tied to IN), the FCC/NAVC MCUs and their crystals, boot/reset switches, I2C buses and pull-ups, the PCA9685 (A0 high = 0x41, avoiding a conflict with the INA219 on the same FCC I2C2 bus), the W25N01 SPI NAND with WP/HOLD pulled high, the sensor set, and the inter-MCU UART2/I2C/GPIO links, the drawing matches the specification and standard practice. The only apparent oddities (PCA9685 note 0x41 vs spec table 0x40, EEPROM/INA219 address annotations, reference-number drift between the schematic notes and the drawn designators, and the barometer RESET/EOC mix-up) are either spec transcription artifacts or the documented V1 bug, and do not represent an electrical deviation; no anomaly is supported by the drawing.
